old_title: Asos app users sent 'hacked' message from online retailer
new_title: ASOS says customers sent notifications in possible hack
old_text:
Asos 'investigating' phone message sent saying online retailer had been 'hacked'
In short:
Asos app users have been sent a phone notification claiming the online fashion retailer had been hacked.
The UK company's share prices slumped 10 per cent after.
What's next?
Asos says it is "aware of the notification and investigating".
new_text:
ASOS and authorities investigating phone message sent saying online retailer had been hacked
In short:
ASOS says customers' personal information may have been accessed during "unauthorised activity".
ASOS app users were sent a phone notification claiming the online fashion retailer had been hacked.
What's next?
ASOS is working with authorities to investigate the breach.
